field.name: title
field.comment: The text displayed above the search box

field.name: buttonText
field.comment: The text of the button that starts the search

field.name: baseSearchPath
field.comment: The path of the page whose descendants are searched (empty: the whole site)

field.name: search_all
field.comment: true: every site of the installation is searched, and baseSearchPath is ignored; false or NULL: only the current site is searched

field.name: allow_user_options
field.comment: true: the visitors can choose whether to search every site of the installation; false or NULL: they can't

field.name: postTo_cID
field.comment: The ID of the page that displays the results (NULL: they are displayed in the page holding the block, or at resultsURL)

field.name: resultsURL
field.comment: The address the search is sent to (used if postTo_cID is NULL)
